channel.title: North Wales Chronicle - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Chronicle (northwaleschronicle.co.uk)

item.title: Auction house announces year-long charity partnership with Wales Air Ambulance
item.description: Rogers Jones Auctioneers partners with Wales Air Ambulance raising charity funds for vital Welsh emergency service via auctions and fundraising events.

item.title: Bangor man exchanged in sexual communication with a child in Llandudno
item.description: A man from Bangor who engaged in sexual communication with a child in Llandudno has been handed a community order.

item.title: Rats spotted inside this North Wales hospital sparking patient safety fears
item.description: Health chiefs have confirmed rodents were seen inside a pre‑op clinic at Ysbyty Glan Clwyd after rats gnawed through gaps around pipework. The board insists there is “no infestation”, but a councillor says the situation is “totally unacceptable” and could deter patients from attending.

item.title: Search for wanted Anglesey man amid police appeal
item.description: A search is underway for a wanted man from Anglesey.

item.title: New ‘off-grid’ waterfall hideaway in Gwynedd now open for bookings
item.description: Shacks’ new off-grid waterfall cabin near Bala, offers a secluded stay with stunning views and an outdoor bath.

item.title: Safety upgrade at historic Eryri reservoir approved to guard against major flooding
item.description: Essential safety work to protect against the potential flooding of an Eryri reservoir during major weather events has been given the green light.

item.title: Former Gwynedd specialist care home that closed last year on market for £1m
item.description: The home, registered for 22 residents, features a main detached stone-built Grade II-listed property with 14 bedrooms and historic features.

item.title: Is it safe to travel to Turkey? UK government's new advice amid Middle East conflict
item.description: The Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) has updated its latest travel advice for those heading to Turkey from the UK amid Middle East conflict

item.title: Councillor warns Holyhead shoppers at risk as lorries ‘take over’ car parks
item.description: An Anglesey councillor says pedestrians are being put in danger as large lorries continue parking on Holyhead’s shop car parks, blaming winter storms and a lack of proper facilities for a problem he fears could lead to “an accident or worse”.

item.title: Bangor shop ordered to close by court for selling illegal tobacco and vapes
item.description: The ruling means that the shop, now named ‘Top Shop’ will remain closed for three months.
